descEn: ON and OFF — the computer's only language!
descDa: TÆNDT og SLUKKET — computerens eget sprog!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: Binary = base-2. Computer transistors = ON(1) or OFF(0). Bedtime story reinforce: electricity = switch. Each bit = position value (1,2,4,8). Right to left doubles.
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Binary is base-2. Each bit position doubles in value left to right.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Binære tal er base-2. Computere bruger bittransistorer, der kun kan være TÆNDT (1) eller SLUKKET (0). Hver bit-position fordobles fra højre mod venstre (1, 2, 4, 8).
teacherGuide.storyGu: '4 bulbs — right bulb = 1, next = 2, next = 4, next = 8. ON karo 1 + 2 = 3. Computer exactly same! Phone number, photo, music — all stored as ON/OFF bulbs!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Imagine 4 lightbulbs with values 8, 4, 2, 1. If 4 and 1 are ON, we have 4+1 = 5. Everything on your tablet is just bulbs!
teacherGuide.storyDa: Forestil dig 4 pærer med værdierne 8, 4, 2, 1. Hvis pærerne 4 og 1 lyser (er TÆNDT), har vi 4+1 = 5. Alt på en iPad eller computer er gemt sådan!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'Ready for secret code? 0101 = ? 4+1=5! Only computer scientists know this!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Ready for secret code? 0110 = ? 4+2=6! You are a computer scientist now!
teacherGuide.scriptDa: Er du klar til en hemmelig spionkode? 0110 = ? 4 + 2 = 6! Du tænker som en rigdig programmør!
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Light switches demo! 4 switches, assign values 8,4,2,1. Flip and calculate together physically!
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Tape down 4 squares on the floor: [8], [4], [2], [1]. Step in squares to add them up!
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Læg 4 papirlapper på gulvet med tallene 8, 4, 2, 1. Hop på felterne for at lægge dem sammen!

questions.hintEn: Electricity is only ON(1) or OFF(0)!
questions.hintDa: Strømmen er enten TÆNDT (1) eller SLUKKET (0)!
